name: game_exception_abort
exceptional_convention: register-controlled exception entry: zero jumps to the watchdog-abort address; nonzero falls through to game_start

name: game_start
exceptional_convention: OS reset entry through JMP veneer 0x40000; initializes palette/profile pointers, sets SR=0x2300, and tail-jumps to g2mainloop

name: game_vblank
exceptional_convention: 68010 interrupt entry through veneer 0x40006; saves/restores D0-D1/A0-A2; may take the watchdog-abort path or jump through the reset vector instead of returning

name: sound_system_reset
exceptional_convention: normal stack; calls OS reset_sound_cpu(0,0), installs 180-frame grace, clears state/retries, and resets queue

name: sound_queue_reset
exceptional_convention: frameless leaf; fills all eight slots with 0xFF and zeroes byte head/tail indices

name: enqueue_sound
exceptional_convention: normal-stack leaf; capacity is seven entries and a full queue silently drops the new byte

name: alpha_clear_rect
arguments: uint16 column, uint16 width, uint16 row, uint16 height
exceptional_convention: normal stack; exact dimensions in alpha words/rows, 64-word (0x80-byte) row stride; zero width or height writes nothing
